text.en:
While inside a Rift or Well of Radiance:
+100 Reload with 0.9x <title RDS [rds] /> to all Guardians inside.

While inside an <bold Empowering Rift /> or Well of Radiance:
100% Increased Damage Falloff Distance.

title rds (
Reload Duration Scalar (Multiplies Reload Animation Duration by that number)
)
text.ko:
빛의 샘이나 균열안에 있을 떄:
안에 있는 수호자의 재장전 속도를 100 만큼 증가시킵니다.

빛의 샘이나 강화의 균열안에 있을 때:
무기의 사거리가 2배로 증가합니다.

为所有在内的守护者提供 +100 装填速度，0.9 倍<title 装填动画系数 [G_rds] />。

text.en:
Rifts and <solar/>Wells of Radiance you cast grant 100 Reload Speed and a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier to all weapons for you and allies inside them.

<bold Empowering /> Rifts and <solar/>Wells of Radiance you cast also double the Damage Falloff Distance of weapons.

Rifts and <solar/>Wells of Radiance you cast grant 100 Reload Speed and a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier to all weapons for you and allies inside them. Effect is tied to the rift, even if the exotic is removed.

<bold Empowering /> Rifts and <solar/>Wells of Radiance you cast also grant 50% increased Damage Falloff Distance to Weapons.

<primary/> Primary Weapons recieve the following bonuses while hipfiring:
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance

<yellow DMT />, <yellow Last Word />, and <yellow Tommy's Matchbook /> are uniquely tuned and do not recieve as significant of a benefit.

Rifts and <solar/>Wells of Radiance you cast grant 100 Reload Speed and a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier to all weapons for you and allies inside them. Effect is tied to the rift, even if the exotic is removed.

<bold Empowering /> Rifts and <solar/>Wells of Radiance you cast also grant 50% increased Damage Falloff Distance to Weapons.
